subject: Haunted Towers super charge
text: In Haunted Towers, the super charge has to be done going left, not right.

evidence.quote: Spent a lot of lives thinking I had to go right with the super charge but I actually had to go left

subject: locked box at the end of Haunted Towers
requires: Race the knights up the stairs before they wake up
text: The locked box at the end of Haunted Towers is opened by racing the knights up the stairs before they wake up.

evidence.quote: it just turns out that you have to race those knights up the stairs before they wake up

subject: grenadier gnorc
text: A grenadier gnorc near the end of Haunted Towers can cause a red gem to go missing when it falls or when its gem falls after being killed.

evidence.quote: turns out a grenadier gnorc near the end fell or his gem fell when it got killed

subject: Sky Sliding
requires: Find all 300 jewels in Icy Flight
text: Sky Sliding did not trigger for one commenter when the connection dropped as they were ending the level and the game saved.

evidence.quote: this one did not appear since it cut off right as I was ending the level, the game saved

subject: Sky Sliding
text: After missing Sky Sliding, one commenter had to replay the game up to the Dream Weavers point to get another attempt.

evidence.quote: had to go through the game again in 2 hours to the point of Dream Weavers to get a chance at this one again

subject: Gnasty's World
text: In Gnasty's World, the first dragon is freed on entering and the second appears only after defeating Gnasty Gnorc.

evidence.quote: You get the first dragon as soon as you enter the world, and you have to defeat Gnasty Gnorc for the second one to appear

subject: A Harbor Full of Gnorcs
text: One commenter reported the A Harbor Full of Gnorcs achievement triggered in RetroArch but not on the website.

evidence.quote: So annoyed this didn't trigger (well it did in RetroArch but not on the website for some reason)
